method: Ambergris Caye and Caye Caulker, from Rocky Point and Bacalar Chico in the north to the Caye Caulker Marine Reserve in the south; the atoll trips these shops run are counted in belize-atolls. No official site list could be read: the Hol Chan Marine Reserve site (holchanbelize.org) returned HTTP 522 and the reserve's zones (A-D) are areas, not dive sites. Operator lists, one each: Ambergris Divers' 32-site page (Sun Breeze Hotel's dive shop is Ambergris Divers, counted once), Ramon's Village Divers' trip page, Ecologic Divers' dive-trip page, Frenchie's Diving (Caye Caulker), Amigos del Mar's tour pages, Belize Pro Dive Center's Hol Chan page and White Sands Dive Shop's tour page. The Belize Tourism Board's two diving articles (travelbelize.org) count together as one tourism-board list. Belize Diving Services now redirects to Elite Adventures, whose pages name no sites; Reef Adventures names local sites only as snorkel stops; Chuck & Robbie's and Amigos' old domain refused connections; ambergriscaye.com returned 403 and is a lodging guide in any case. Island Expeditions' Belize dive map, DiveSSI, Lonely Planet, scubadiving.com and Undercurrent were read for leads only. A site is counted when it is named, recreationally divable on scuba and on at least two lists; spellings that clearly name the same spur-and-groove site (Tuffy Canyon/Tuffy Canyons, Mata/Mata Rocks Canyons, Cypress Canyons/Tunnels) are one row. Shark Ray Alley and Mexico Rocks are excluded as snorkel stops, and one-list names stay as excluded rows. Counted 2026-10-14.
